class.name: MaszynaLegacyAnimationAction
class.description: Moves a submodel of its model instances towards the given angles or offset at a speed (animation_event, [code]Event.cpp:1569-1716[/code]). [code]digital[/code] and [code].vmd[/code] animations are not ported.

members.member: The [E3DRenderingServer] instances whose submodel is moved.
Whether [member target] is a rotation or an offset.
The name of the submodel moved.
The angles about the submodel's x, y and z [deg], or its offset [m], it moves towards.

constants.constant: [member target] is degrees about the submodel's x, y and z.
